name: Enterprise Knowledge Assistant
description: Search enterprise policies and knowledge, look up employees, budgets, departments and contracts, and redact personal information. Read-only and least-privilege by default.
description_zh: 检索企业制度与知识库，查询员工、预算、部门与合同信息，并对个人信息脱敏；默认只读、最小权限。
description_en: Search enterprise policies and knowledge, look up employees, budgets, departments and contracts, and redact personal information. Read-only and least-privilege by default.
examples_zh: 公司的年假制度是怎么规定的？
技术中心还剩多少部门预算？
员工韩梅梅的部门、职位和年假余额是多少？
把这段文字里的手机号和身份证号做脱敏
examples_en: What is the company's annual leave policy?
How much department budget does the tech center have left?
What are Han Meimei's department, title and annual leave balance?
Redact the phone number and ID card in this text
